# Utah Pool Experts

> Swimming pool & spa cleaning, maintenance, and equipment repair on Utah's
> Wasatch Front — weekly service routes, chemical balancing, factory-trained
> repair techs, and seasonal openings & closings. Serving Utah since 1996.

## About

Utah Pool Experts is a one-stop service provider for swimming pool cleaning,
maintenance, and repair, based in Orem, Utah. Since 1996 we've specialized in
weekly pool and spa care, pool equipment repair, water analysis, and chemical
wash services. Uniformed, factory-trained technicians on set routes; estimates
in writing; fully licensed and insured.

- Region: Utah — Wasatch Front (based in Orem, Utah County)
- Address: 308 West 800 North, Orem, UT 84057
- Cities served: Orem, Provo, Lehi, American Fork, Pleasant Grove, Lindon,
  Springville, Spanish Fork, Saratoga Springs, Eagle Mountain, Highland,
  Alpine, Draper, Sandy, Salt Lake City
- Counties served: Utah, Salt Lake, Wasatch
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8:30am–5:30pm; Sat–Sun closed
- Price tier: residential & commercial ($$)

## Frequently asked

### How do estimates work?
Call, text, or send the estimate form. We ask about pool type, size, and
condition, then put a service plan and price in writing — free, no obligation.

### Do you service salt water pools?
Yes — chlorine, salt water, and spas/hot tubs, residential and commercial.

### When should a Utah pool be opened and closed?
Most Wasatch Front pools open April–May and close September–October. Proper
winterization matters here: freeze damage is the most expensive repair we see.

### My pool is green — can you fix it?
Yes. We do green-pool recovery, drain-downs, and chemical washes, then set up
a maintenance plan so it doesn't happen again.
